name: Checklist Tick-Draw
easing: box EASE.inOut 10f; text wipe EASE.inOut 16f; tick EASE.back 12f; rows staggered 20f from f8
bestFor: Listing 2-4 short criteria or features that all get ticked off.
notSuitable: More than 4 items or long sentences.
keyframeTable: row 1 tick being drawn; row 2 box+text appearing
all rows ticked, last tick drawing
rest: 3 rows x (64px box + 56px text + orange tick)
script: Each row: a rough 64px box draws, the text wipes in beside it, then an orange tick draws over the box with overshoot.
colorRules: Ticks orange (one group); boxes and text cream.
